description: Lightweight real elevation raster for the Terrain guide playground.
source: Mapzen Terrarium elevation tiles, via the Autark v4.0.0 gallery dataset
processing: Cropped the Autark 2134 x 1503 raster to the Praias da Baía extract extent with a 100 m margin, limited by the source bounds. Source pixel window [0, 241, 766, 1134], bilinearly resampled with geotiff 3.0.5 to 439 x 512 pixels. EPSG:3395 and Float32 heights preserved; no vertical exaggeration.
